facts.business: Shiva Cement Limited is a subsidiary of JSW Cement Limited engaged in cement manufacturing with clinker production capacity of 1.32 MTPA and grinding capacity of 1 MTPA in Odisha, India.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: 1.32 MTPA, commenced commercial operation in June 2023
1 MTPA, partnership with Bhushan Power & Steel Limited

auditor.name: SHAH GUPTA & CO., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty related to going concern - Company incurred loss of Rs 12,553.25 lakhs during year ended March 31, 2026 and accumulated loss of Rs 55,918.59 lakhs resulting in erosion of net worth. Financial statements prepared on going concern basis dependent on future business plan performance.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to accumulated losses and erosion of net worth
Commodity price risk from fluctuations in coal and pet coke prices affecting production costs
Liquidity risk with current ratio of 0.28 times (down from 0.56 times)
Significant management judgment required for mines restoration provision estimation
facts.related_party_note: The Company has entered into transactions with related parties in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act. Details disclosed in Financial Statements as required under Ind AS 24. 1 MTPA grinding capacity achieved through partnership with group company Bhushan Power and Steel Limited. CSR spending of Rs 295.04 lakhs spent by JSW Cement Limited, Holding Company.
